scope: CPU-only review of complete JSON metrics; GPU inference and full prediction hash audit are the parent summarizer responsibility
limitations: One seed and two cycles; no statistical significance or general efficacy claim.
Three empty supervision crops were deterministically replaced before the full audit; conclusions apply to that nonempty constraint.
Probe texture comes from training reference: useful controlled diagnostics, not independent held-out scenes.
Native reference includes scored frames and uses three disjoint windows from the same scene; this is not independent clean truth or a multi-scene test.
No unseen-sensor or real-motion acceptance is established by these metrics.
Exact branch starting states do not imply deterministic GPU trajectories; strict end-to-end tolerance check failed and tiny variability also appeared in repeated uninterrupted runs.
This ablation isolates combined crop/window/noise refresh under fixed source/gain scheduling; it does not isolate dynamic supervision, loss components, or each refresh component.
More high-frequency energy or less temporal MAD alone does not establish true detail or motion fidelity.

history_aware_next_step.first: Audit whether new low-gain dynamic multi-scene clips and same-time targets exist; reuse the A7 capture manifest and validator, with scene-disjoint validation and fixed-ISP target inspection.
history_aware_next_step.if_data_available: Prepare exact same-frame clean/noisy dynamic pairs and freeze an independent evaluation set before designing a bounded dynamic-supervision comparison.
history_aware_next_step.if_data_missing: Report data gap and provide concrete capture or target-domain data requirements; retain A3 and do not present further same-scene scalar tuning as a validated next solution.
avoid_repeating: Historical A5 identified continuation-related native drift with a matched control. A12 does not separately isolate Adam reset, common sampling schedule, supervision, and their interactions; do not attribute all regression to static supervision or sampling alone.
A5 noisy aligned teacher-anchor and simple learning-rate/freeze sweeps did not produce a promotable result.
A6 one-scene same-frame targets, teacher motion distillation, and single-reference procedural motion failed to deliver stable real dynamic gains.
A7 old-teacher residual fusion had 36 rejected configurations; a higher motion ratio alone is insufficient.

data_gate_details.scenes: At least 4 train and 2 validation scenes, with no physical-scene overlap.
data_gate_details.clips: Five motion types per scene; at least 30 clips and 160 consecutive frames each (4,800 frames).
data_gate_details.targets: Native low-gain dynamic RAW with same-time frame content; create noisy input by calibrated A2 corruption of the same target frame.
data_gate_details.pipeline: Disable spatial/temporal NR and auto exposure/gain/WB; fixed gain/FPS and per-clip capture settings; retain numerical provenance.
data_gate_details.automatic_gate: Use existing A7 validator for RAW format, noise, saturation, stability, and meaningful motion coverage.
data_gate_details.manual_gate: Every validation clip requires fixed-ISP review of motion exposure blur, moving fine texture, NR trails, CFA/black/storage alignment, and true scene independence.
data_gate_details.scope_limit: Same-frame synthetic noise pairs are a prerequisite development source, not proof of transfer to real high-gain motion or unseen sensors.

primary_native_conclusions: Refresh EMA improves RMSE by 0.03430–0.03724 DN and PSNR by 0.03444–0.03672 dB relative to fixed EMA in all three windows, with a slight reduction in flat residual sigma.
Refresh EMA still regresses against A3 in all three windows: RMSE +0.24030–0.26908 DN, PSNR -0.27010 to -0.23749 dB, and flat residual sigma +0.08630–0.09187 DN.

Refresh EMA temporal MAD is slightly higher than both A3 and fixed EMA in all windows; its high-frequency amplitude ratio is slightly lower than both in all windows. These two metrics alone cannot prove blur, detail fidelity, or temporal quality.
Both probe and native primary results favor retaining A3: modest refresh-versus-fixed improvement does not produce a candidate better than A3.

A shared continuation-stage regression does not isolate static supervision as its sole cause. This experiment does not separate the effects of Adam reset, the common source/gain schedule, optimization trajectory, supervision, or their interactions.
final_model_conclusions: The refresh live model improves native reconstruction against A3 in all three windows (PSNR +0.0877158563/+0.0829578955/+0.0572897320 dB); do not state that all model/EMA candidates regress native reconstruction.
This is not a joint native quality gain: refresh live-model flat residual sigma and temporal MAD are higher than both A3 and fixed live model in every window; HF amplitude ratio is lower than both.

Every refresh live-model moving-patch reconstruction, high-pass, gradient, and temporal-difference error is worse than A3 and worse than refresh EMA; RMSE increase versus A3 is 9.0894843354–13.8394103659 DN.
The refresh model has worse reconstruction on 6/8 motion cases versus A3. Static probe reconstruction/high-pass/gradient improve on 4/4, while static temporal-difference error worsens on 4/4.

EMA and live-model differences make the native result sensitive to weight averaging and are consistent with EMA lag, but do not identify lag as the sole cause or prove that more training will improve the EMA.
EMA remains the predeclared primary state. Even if live weights had been eligible for promotion, the joint detail, motion, and flat-region behavior does not support replacing A3.

Do not extend training solely to wait for EMA: future parameter trajectory is unknown, and the current live weights still fail motion diagnostics. Preserve this native positive finding as a research observation and proceed to supervision/data qualification.

final_versioned_evidence_review.scientific_assessment: Accurately retains positive refresh-model native PSNR while reporting flat residual, temporal, and motion regressions; no joint quality acceptance or continuation benefit claimed.
